parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked the code for any use of argv[1] beyond passing it to inFile.open(). The std::ifstream::open() call merely opens a file with the specified path; it does not invoke a shell or any OS command execution function. Therefore the data from argv[1] cannot influence command execution, so the CWE‑78 claim is unfounded.
